name: Orra — AI Note Taker
description: A dusk-lit, dark landing page for Orra, an AI note-taker: an amber-to-cobalt hero whose headline follows a device frame writing live notes for meetings, calls, interviews and ideas, a numbered feature list, a drifting wall of monochrome app tiles and HTML recorders, a fan of meeting notes, autoplaying workspace tabs (summaries, action items, Ask Orra) under a violet spotlight, customer stories, a privacy pitch on a planet of digits, support, CTA and a product rail — frosted glass, pill controls and hairlines throughout, plus brand guidelines.
designedFor: AI productivity, note-taking and meeting tools that want a calm, premium dark landing page
Products with a live UI to show — a device frame, tabs and mockups instead of stock photography
Seeing a frosted-glass, pill-and-hairline dark design system applied end to end, editable in the canvas editor
